children: Sadot Group entered into a side letter with its institutional investor to amend its senior secured convertible notes issued under the July 16, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement for up to $100 million. The amendment revises the definition of the conversion Floor Price across the notes and eliminates the Adjusted Floor Price concept. The terms of the other transaction documents remain unchanged. The move is intended to streamline conversion mechanics and provide financing flexibility.
